clauses.content: An order must have delivered status and a recorded delivery date before a return can be approved.
A return request must be made within 30 days after the recorded delivery date. Day 30 is inside the return window; after day 30 is outside it.
An item marked final sale cannot be returned under the simulated MVP policy.
An item with an existing return request must not create a second return request.
The return reason is required before the system can finish evaluating a return request.
The requester must identify the order using the matching customer email before the system reveals order details or evaluates that customer's return.
Defective or wrong-item claims, reported damage, conflicting facts, and explicit requests for a person go to human review rather than automatic approval.
For a non-defective return, the item must be unused. If use status is unknown, the system asks before deciding; a used item is not eligible for automatic return.

Meeting the MVP policy conditions makes the item eligible, but the system creates only a simulated return request after the customer explicitly confirms it. No real refund or shipping label is issued.
